criteria_scores.name: Hook strength
criteria_scores.notes: First sentence (~163 chars) lands before the LinkedIn 'see more' cutoff, names subject, role, org, $500M, and the procedural action. Decision is the hook, not the bio.

criteria_scores.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria_scores.notes: Subject is founder/CEO with direct ownership of the lease decision. Consequence named with sector, dollar figure, power capacity, workforce, land tenure, and timeframe.

criteria_scores.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria_scores.notes: Full name + role + institutional affiliation + Anchorage tie all present. Every fact matches the dossier.

criteria_scores.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria_scores.notes: Hard-fail cleared. Decision named with what, when, and binary. Primary-source URL slug matches the dossier exactly. Northern Journal corroborating URL also present.

criteria_scores.name: Structural read
criteria_scores.notes: Post explicitly labels the project 'mediocre-to-speculative' with five named structural gaps. Acknowledges genuine strategic logic without retreating. Slight density deduction.

criteria_scores.name: Forward implication
criteria_scores.notes: Names the next decision, the specific deadline (June 15), and three concrete watchpoints.

criteria_scores.name: Voice match
criteria_scores.notes: Analytical, position-taking, business-literate throughout. Minor density in one compressed sentence.

criteria_scores.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria_scores.notes: 434 words, ~2,899 chars. Structural read paragraph runs long; long URLs in paragraph 3 disrupt scan flow.

criteria_scores.name: Engagement question
criteria_scores.notes: Tied directly to the specific structural gaps named. Real, debatable, not generic.

criteria_scores.name: Anti-puff guard
criteria_scores.notes: Bio recap minimal. Decision treatment dominates. Position taken with named accountability beat (STAK declining questions).
